message: `watch` on a reactive root compares the same proxy identity, so later new-value work never runs
help: Vue reuses the reactive object for `old` and `new` on nested changes. Compare a field, watch a getter, or drop the identity guard.

message: `watch(state)` deep-tracks the reactive root; prefer a getter or explicit sources
help: Use `watch(() => state.field, …)` or `watch(() => ({ … }), …)` so dependencies stay precise.
